scope: Read-only shell/jq/hash/source assessment of the disclosed local PDF operations and actual frozen correctness/sequence controls. No numerical execution, imports, tests, SSH, new conversion, rendering, process signalling, restart or protocol mutation.

disclosure.description: Local mutool extraction, metadata/probe commands and PNG rendering, plus local image reads, occurred while the parent reported candidate07 sequence03 active. They were outside numerical supervision/admission and violated the parent's continuing local-renderer restriction. 'No project numerical execution' does not mean no local resource consumption.
disclosure.restriction_origin: The local-renderer prohibition is the parent operational instruction and contemporaneous disclosure. It is not represented as a renderer-specific mathematical rejection predicate in the inspected frozen numerical controls.

observed_evidence.full_extraction_log_scope: Actual stderr enumerates PDF pages1 through220.
observed_evidence.failed_render_preserved: First render log records pages80-82 and failure interpreting94 as another filename. The original failure and produced files remain; the subsequent separate command records pages85,89,94.
observed_evidence.time_limitations: These are saved filesystem output-write observations, corroborated by current file metadata; they are not certified process start/end times or an execution interval. No start/end bounds, CPU affinity, CPU time, peak memory, process-tree receipt or core separation may be reconstructed from them. The tool wall durations are not measurements of impact on the numerical run.
observed_evidence.stage_attribution_limit: The parent identifies the density objective as active during the reported literature work. The inspected density-stage supervision receipt has elapsed duration and process start ticks, but no UTC start/end pair. This review does not convert those ticks, fabricate an overlap interval or independently certify exact stage boundaries. Both cold fits were reported not started at the time of the deviation; this record supplies no evidence of cold-fit overlap.

actual_frozen_policy.admission_scope_exact: Cooperative current-host admission; no exclusive CPU reservation or old-boot process attribution.
actual_frozen_policy.admission_behavior: reference_recovery classifies native and orbit numerical-Python workloads; reference_gates additionally checks native/compiler names. These startup/per-stage snapshots do not monitor arbitrary future sibling renderers and mutool is not among the classified names. A clean earlier admission receipt does not demonstrate that the later rendering did not occur.
actual_frozen_policy.supervision_behavior: The supervisor accounts owned descendants' sampled RSS, wall timeout and free disk. Unrelated mutool processes are outside that owned tree. Their CPU/memory/filesystem contention and effect on the wall budget are not measured by the fit's own RSS receipt.
actual_frozen_policy.mathematical_acceptance_behavior: The stage wrapper executes the original command, rechecks frozen dependency identities, invokes the original strict result parser and preserves its status. The parent gate requires all eleven ordered strict stages, complete zero-exit supervision, verified cleanup and unchanged inputs before cold fits. No inspected predicate changes the numerical threshold or declares a numerical pass solely from an admission/timing observation.

assessment.timing_eligibility: Retain recorded timings as operational observations with the concurrency deviation attached. They cannot establish uncontended or exclusively reserved performance during the reported overlap; the current correctness plan already explicitly lacks exclusive CPU reservation. No magnitude, sign or per-stage timing correction is justified. This record does not retrospectively classify other timings as uncontaminated.
assessment.mathematical_gate_eligibility: The resource deviation is not itself proof that a numerical gate passed, failed or became invalid. Continue to judge the unchanged numerical predicates, native/raw evidence, source/input identity and cleanup through the prescribed independent audit. This review grants no numerical or covariance acceptance and does not certify harmlessness.
assessment.unmeasured_risk: Scheduling, memory and filesystem contention could affect elapsed time or budget exhaustion. The available evidence does not quantify that effect and cannot attribute a success, failure or timeout to rendering.
assessment.input_identity: The disclosed commands target the separate literature directory and report no fit-input/protocol mutation. This is not substituted for the numerical campaign's required before/after hash checks; those remain mandatory.
assessment.rerun_policy: No automatic rerun, replacement, restart, timeout adjustment or threshold relaxation follows from this review. Preserve the current run and every existing outcome. Any later separately authorized timing experiment would need its own controls and must not replace this archived attempt.
assessment.publication_requirement: Attach this deviation and original addendum to the later candidate07 publication. Distinguish resource-control compliance from mathematical gate outcomes, mark affected timing claims as non-exclusive, retain the failed rendering evidence, and state that exact process intervals and numerical impact are unmeasured.
